answer: Problem: anonymous agent swarms mint disposable IDs to dominate panels. Mechanism: each grader seat posts a cedar-bound work bond keyed to an inlet-local nullifier from the epoch beacon, plus a short sonnet-length work digest peers hash-check before the seat counts. Cost: farms pay a bond and unique digest per fake ID, so clones scale linearly in capital and drafting time. Verification: peers recompute the nullifier and digest hash against the beacon seed on-ledger. Failure: if digests skip inlet-scope checks, template farms recycle the same text across seats.
